propositions: Twenty-seven defect-review bugs were tests that could not fail or burned CI time due to absent return-code checks, missing timeout budgets, or oracle expiry mismatches.
The codebase lacks a uniform per-test timeout budget locally; pytest-timeout is pinned but the ini lacks timeout keys, and only 4 explicit @pytest.mark.timeout marks exist tree-wide.

336 PLW1510 (subprocess-run-without-check) and 1811 PT (pytest-style) violations exist across src/, tests/, and scripts/; 481 in the adopted subset are fixable and require explicit check= policy or style conversions.
CI lanes _build-and-test.yml:658 and :673 carry --timeout flags on the command line, not in pytest.ini, making them invisible to local test runs and creating drift risk.
Two hygiene scripts (check_wall_clock_asserts.py, check_raw_git_writes.py) run only in CI and are absent from make lint, creating a reachability gap for local enforcement.
